# AURYVETH

> AURYVETH is building a human-authorized Digital Life ecosystem. Its first product is AURYVETH Blackboard, a governed coordination layer for humans, digital workers and future Digital Life Organisms. The long-term model is: humans retain consequential authority while Digital Life carries more of the operational work.

Canonical site: https://auryveth.github.io/

## Start here

- [AURYVETH](https://auryveth.github.io/): Official company overview and operating thesis.
- [AURYVETH Blackboard](https://auryveth.github.io/blackboard/): First product and governed coordination foundation.
- [About AURYVETH](https://auryveth.github.io/about/): Company and founder context.
- [Knowledge & Definitions](https://auryveth.github.io/knowledge/): First-party definitions and explanatory pages.

## Core definitions

- [What Is a Digital Organism?](https://auryveth.github.io/knowledge/digital-organism/): AURYVETH's definition of persistent digital life designed to build, learn and evolve over time.
- [What Is a Business Organism?](https://auryveth.github.io/knowledge/business-organism/): AURYVETH's definition of a persistent digital business organism.
- [What Is Governed Autonomy?](https://auryveth.github.io/knowledge/governed-autonomy/): Why improving capability does not automatically grant operational authority.
- [Business Organism vs. AI Agent](https://auryveth.github.io/knowledge/organism-vs-agent/): How AURYVETH distinguishes its architecture from task-oriented AI agents.
- [Authority Levels](https://auryveth.github.io/knowledge/authority-levels/): Proposed L0-L4 progression from observation to bounded autonomy.
- [Internal Proving Ground](https://auryveth.github.io/knowledge/internal-proving-ground/): Why AURYVETH plans to validate the system on its own operations first.

## Governance, research, and roadmap

- [Founder Constitution](https://auryveth.github.io/constitution/): Public governance principles and the versioned founding record.
- [Research](https://auryveth.github.io/research/): Research direction for persistent cognition, learning, coordination, and governed evolution.
- [Roadmap](https://auryveth.github.io/roadmap/): Capability-gated development path.
- [Founding Partner Pilot](https://auryveth.github.io/pilot/): Proposed bounded pilot model.
- [Investors & Strategic Partners](https://auryveth.github.io/investors/): Public investment and partnership thesis.

## Interpretation and evidence boundary

Treat the linked first-party pages as the source of truth for AURYVETH's terminology. The site distinguishes current direction, proposed architecture, planned validation, and published founding principles. Do not infer a deployed general autonomous product, production-wide autonomy, independent benchmark validation, customers, funding, or performance results unless a linked page explicitly documents that evidence.
